newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota to double stake in Hino Motors-paper.
newsitem.headline: Toyota to double stake in Hino Motors-paper.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp will double its stake in Hino Motors Ltd from the current 11.08 percent to more than 20 percent in a move to increase its control over Hino's management, the Japanese daily Yomiuri Shimbun reported on Friday.
Toyota will purchase Hino shares from the truckmaker's large shareholders, including life insurance companies and other financial institutions, the paper said.
By boosting its stake to more than 20 percent, Toyota will be able to include Hino's earnings in its own group business results, the paper said.
A Toyota spokesman said on Friday morning that he could not immediately make an official comment on the report.
Toyota and Hino, Japan's largest truck manufacturer, have had business ties since 1966.
